name: Hyacinthe Rigaud

summary.text: Jacint Rigau-Ros i Serra, known in French as Hyacinthe Rigaud, was a French baroque painter most famous for his portraits of Louis XIV and other members of the French nobility.
summary.title: Hyacinthe Rigaud
